/bin/bash -lc "cat > PROGRESS.md <<'EOF'
Round 4 selected election_safety; first dependency was candidate/term-specific genuine reply provenance. Actual RequestVoteReply now echoes request_term/candidate, Raft::request_vote constructs those fields from the request, and send_vote_request checks them against its actual initiating RPC before setting a vote bit. The corresponding Message::Response and next_votes relations carry/check the same fields. This repairs an overbroad model association; no reachable unsafe executable reply trace was established.

Added shared executable vote_history.rs Machine, used by Core and by actual timer/term/vote/reply handlers. Its erased Ghost map records actual vote decisions by term. Verified initialization, checked timeout, request_vote, advance, heartbeat and reply preserve the current-vote/history relation and extend old historical decisions without changing them, conditional on the prior local invariant. The partial cluster adapter projects that exact ghost map, computes its updates from the same operations, and initializes/preserves valid_history. preserve_sends proves every granted reply in the cumulative fixed-support send sequence is backed by its sender's historical vote for the echoed request term/candidate. Old send records remain backed after later term changes. No vote correctness was moved into support::exchange.

quorum.rs now proves disjoint_bound and majority intersection for arbitrary finite boolean ledgers, and certificate_unique under explicit per-voter history-backed certificate premises. Those premises are NOT yet discharged by initialized candidate ledgers. The cluster election theorem therefore remains OPEN; no conditional lemma was exported as an unconditional target. Next first dependency is proving every true candidate vote bit is backed by a genuine response to that candidate's election (or its own recorded self-vote), then transporting certificates through immutable histories and applying intersection. Relevant functions: send_vote_request, next_votes, preserve_sends, preserve_history and quorum::certificate_unique. Next check: python3 scripts/check.py top election_safety after those caller/invariant premises are discharged, plus safety for composition.

Real evidence: final expanded top execution_link passed at runs/checks/1793271088894470618; its imported unit verifies vote-history source contracts, quorum lemmas, send-backed invariant preservation and existing model proofs. All 18 retained 2A/2B/2C tests pass on all seeds 1-5 on the final source in 1793271133822225426 through 1793271138146379738. Final formal composition recheck is recorded in RESULT.md. Snapshot APIs and all application labs remain placeholders; previous nonempty/shape/leader-append passes concern the partial relation only. A build passed during development but its overall checker reported INCOMPLETE for concurrent proof edits; the later unchanged-source tests provide the fresh Cargo build evidence.

Diagnostics repaired: invariant is a Verus keyword, so the source predicate is named valid_vote. Coverage still OPEN: recovery currently restores runtime term/vote/log while ghost pre-crash history must be reattached from proven durable generations; actual caller invariants after restore are not discharged.
